blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven fresh V161 renders: native cloth settling replaces the authored broad radial fan with severe, irregular crumpling. Neutral, three-quarter, front, back and side views show sharp uneven folds and a rumpled hem instead of a clean structured pleated silhouette; prone remains a bunched blanket-like sheet. Appearance remains rejected.

Crouch, sit and prone are armature-skinned snapshots after a neutral-rest cloth bake. The avatar collision body did not move through these poses during the cloth solve. Fresh crouch and sit renders still show abrupt upper-thigh cover edges and separated skirt faces around bent legs, so continuous body collision, coverage and fit remain unverified.

Fresh neutral and three-quarter views retain gray/pinched patches on the lower jacket and a rough, uneven jacket-to-waistband transition. This experiment changed the skirt deformation path only and did not address torso/waist surface artifacts.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
